ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; approximately 98% dark-range pixels against 2% localized high-intensity white pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black substrate across both lobes; no contiguous geometric mottling patterns or macro-level color banding detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous linear boundary, with significant pixel-amplitude peaks located on the distal ends of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large intersecting linear white scars on the left lobe forming a cross pattern; multiple circular depigmented lesions distributed across the trailing half of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'X'-shaped scar constellation on the left lobe is the most unique and distinctive visual identifier in the pixel data.
